purpose: The session side of GUI sleep: a KWin script reports window focus; apps unfocused for 10 min are frozen (via powos-sleepd), thawed on focus or a D-Bus message to them.

processes.name: KWin script powos-sleep
processes.started_by: powos-sleep-gui (org.kde.KWin /Scripting loadScript), unloaded when it stops

remove: pkill -f powos-sleep-gui (the KWin script is unloaded, powos-sleepd thaws every GUI app); rm -rf /usr/lib/powos/apps/powos-sleep-gui /usr/lib/powos/apps/sleep; drop its line from powos-rooted-session
